description.short_caption: Close-up of the eye showing conjunctival injection and periocular skin.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a close-up view of the eye and surrounding periocular skin. The sclera appears white, with no obvious conjunctival injection or discharge visible. The periocular skin shows fine wrinkles and normal pigmentation without overt lesions or swelling. The eyelashes and eyelid margins appear intact and unremarkable.

description.short_caption: Swollen, erythematous lesion on the lower eyelid.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a swollen, erythematous, and tender-appearing lesion on the lower eyelid. The lesion is dome-shaped, with a shiny surface and purplish-red discoloration. Surrounding skin appears mildly inflamed. The eye itself is partially visible, with no obvious discharge or conjunctival involvement in this image.
